recentItems.description:

Douglas Fairbanks Jr. and Peter Fonda host an examination of the history of decency standards for movies, starting in 1922 with the hiring of Will Hays. Jane Russell and others discuss the code, cleavage, and the bullet bra in the 1950s, before a new classification system comes around in the late 1960s. Hollywood Uncensored also features Carroll Baker, Ira Barmak, Joseph I. Breen, Charles Champlin, Will H. Hays, Jayne Mansfield, Marilyn Monroe, Don Murray, and more.
